rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a living being, including an animal, alien, or other organism.

example.english: There may be an unknown creature on Mars.
example.traditional: 火星上面可能有未知嘅生物。
example.jyutping: fo2 sing1 soeng6 min6 ho2 nang4 jau5 mei6 zi1 ge3 saang1 mat6

rows.note: Use this for a mysterious or monstrous creature rather than an ordinary animal.

example.english: I saw a creature by the hillside last night.
example.traditional: 尋晚我喺山邊見到一隻怪物。
example.jyutping: cam4 maan5 ngo5 hai2 saan1 bin1 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 gwaai3 mat6

rows.note: Use this colloquial, dismissive expression for a human being when the English sense is derogatory.

example.jyutping: tiu4 jau5 jau6 hai2 dou6 gong2 daai6 waa6
